Row %1$d, column %2$d, open, no mines around
Row %1$d, column %2$d, the mine you opened
Tap an arrow to slide it off the board.
Make sure its way is clear. If it hits another arrow, that is a mistake.
Clear every arrow. The ones that leave free the others.
Tap a tower to pick up its top disk, then tap another tower to move it.
A bigger disk can never sit on a smaller one.
Bring all the disks to the tower with the flag.
Tap a cell to put a tent. Every tree needs one tent next to it.
Tap again for grass, your note that no tent goes there.
Tents never touch, even at a corner. The numbers say how many tents are in each row and column.
Tap a cell to place a queen.
Queens that share a row, column or diagonal attack each other and turn red. Tap one to take it away.
Place one queen in every row and column to win.
Drag a block along its row or column to slide it.
Or tap a block, then tap an empty cell in its line.
Slide the orange block out through the exit.
Tap a cell to fill it, or drag across cells to fill several.
Tap the cross, then a cell, to mark it as empty.
The numbers tell how many cells in a row are filled. They fade when a line is done.
Fill every row, column and 3×3 box with the numbers 1 to 9, each once.
Tap an empty cell, then tap a number.
Tap the pencil to jot down possible numbers as notes.
The regions are jigsaw shapes. Each row, column and shape needs the numbers 1 to 9, once.
Tap a tile to turn it a quarter.
An open end has a ring. Turn each pipe until it meets its neighbor.
Tap a light to switch it and the lights right next to it.
The lights that were on go out, the ones that were off come on.
Put out every light on the board.
Tap a tile next to the empty space to slide it in.
Tap a tile farther away in the same row or column: the tiles between slide along with it.
Put the numbers in order. A tile turns green when it is in its place.
Tap a number, then an operation, then another number to combine them.
The result takes their place and can be used again. Reach the target to win.
Numbers that would not give a whole number above zero are dimmed.
Tap a tube to lift it, then tap an empty tube to pour into it.
You can also pour onto the same color. The top color moves, as much as fits.
Sort the colors until every tube holds only one color.
Tap a cell to open it. A number tells how many mines touch that cell.
Long-press a cell you think is a mine to flag it.
Double-tap a number that has enough flags to open the cells around it.
Tap a card to turn it over.
Turn over a second card. If the shapes match, the pair stays open.
If they do not match, they turn back. Find every pair to win.
Type a word and press ENTER. You have 6 tries to find the hidden word.
Green is the right place, yellow is in the word but in another place, gray is not in the word.
Use the clues to find the word in as few tries as you can.
Draw one line from 1 to the last number. It must pass every square exactly once.
Drag your finger, or tap a square next to the end of the line. Pass the numbers in order.
Drag back over the line to shorten it.
Tap a number to erase it. Tap it again to bring it back.
The numbers that are left must add up to the sum on the edge. Green means right, red means you erased too much.
Make every row and column add up to its sum to win.
Swipe on the board and the ball slides until a wall or the edge stops it.
The ball paints every cell it passes.
Paint every cell of the board to win.

Squares taken back by the undo button, a restart or a tap on an earlier square all count.

Using a hint costs one star.
